text:
Professor Osita Onyejekwe teaches in the Mathematics department at University of Colorado - Boulder. Overall rating 3.9/5 from 19 ratings; average difficulty 3.5/5; 73.6842% would take again.

Review 1 [CSCI2820] (quality=2.0, difficulty=3.0): You can consistently show up to class, go to office hours, and still struggle in this course. Don't expect to have your grade rounded up (even if it's < 0.5% away from the next letter grade). Extra credit is offered, but didn't help much in my experience. Exams had typos (making 1 problem unsolvable) that were announced hours before the deadline.

Review 2 [CSCI2820] (quality=4.0, difficulty=3.0): This guy is a character, but not in a bad way. He's very kind and approachable, and likes to chat with students. Sometimes he gets distracted in lecture and doesn't finish the day's material so you have to go back in the textbook and read the things he chose not to go over. Could be a more organized lecturer, but generally speaking he is fun.

Review 3 [STAT3400] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Arguably the best professor I've had at CU, super nice, and really cares about students. Not the easiest class ever but Dr O made sure to present the material in an understandable manner.

Review 4 [MATH3195] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Genuinely the most amazing professor I have ever had

Review 5 [STAT3400] (quality=4.0, difficulty=5.0): Very reasonable guy. Goes hard in lectures (heavy proofs) and homeworks and makes the tests a bit easier. The homework rubrics were really nice too, and gave lots of partial credit. Second time having him and I highly suggest taking him for any STAT courses.

Review 6 [STAT3400] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): In my years at CU, I can't recall a single professor that impacted my learning more than professor O. By far the friendliest, most kind-hearted professor I have ever had. This was the first time in my college career where I refused to skip a class. His classes are well constructed and his tests lean towards difficult (as expected for this level).

Review 7 [STAT2600] (quality=4.0, difficulty=3.0): He really cares about the students learning and any confusion you have regardless of how basic it should be, he will help and not make you feel bad about yourself. Hes passionate and it shows. In general this class was on the easier side and the way he structured it was great. Hes definitely a one of a kind type of professor.

Review 8 [APPM1360] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Dr. O is one of the best teachers I have had since coming to CU. He taught APPM 1360 (Calculus 2 for Engineers). He has a great personality and always brings an amazing energy to class that permeates the whole classroom with great enthusiasm. Thanks for everything Dr. O! - Alberto Espinosa (4th down conversion specialist)

Review 9 [APPM1360] (quality=5.0, difficulty=5.0): Dr. O is a very enthusiastic professor. His energy keeps you from falling asleep in class. Which is important when learning the concepts of Calculus 2 for Engineers. Office hours are also extremely helpful! Drippy style 100% of the time. Great class.

Review 10 [STAT3400] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Dr. O is an amazing professor! Always looked forward to going to his class, and he was very accommodating and helpful with anything pertaining to the course material. Yes, the class is difficult but that is because the subject matter is difficult but Dr. O does a great job helping understand the concepts.

Review 11 [APPM1360] (quality=1.0, difficulty=4.0): This class was my first class at Boulder. It is by far the worst class Ive ever taken. I took BC calculus in high school, so Id see all the material before, but somehow the tests/quizzes were still ridiculously hard. Further, I had my high school graduation on the day of a quiz and he requested that I step away to take the quiz. Disrespectful.

Review 12 [STAT3400] (quality=5.0, difficulty=5.0): He does make mistakes sometimes, and can be a little confusing on some topics. But he really cares about the students, often offering curves for tests and extra credits and also extra office hours. He's handwriting is not great, that's the only down side. The class is pretty hard for a 3000's level course but the accomodations he gave help a lot

Review 13 [APPM1360] (quality=2.0, difficulty=5.0): Dr.O made mistakes in lectures more often than he didnt, and students had to correct him often. I felt the need to fact check everything he taught me, because it was only correct 50% of the time. His students were definitely at a disadvantage taking his class versus taking the class with another professor. Great guy, not a great professor.

Review 14 [APPM1360] (quality=5.0, difficulty=4.0): I did not try in his class at all and so i found it difficult. He, however, is a great guy and really cares about his students. He is also very funny which keeps his lectures surprisingly entertaining.

Review 15 [MATH3195] (quality=5.0, difficulty=1.0): Hands down the best professor I've ever had. He cares about his students, provides a all resources for you to succeed. He is accessible out of class. Gives quizzes on a weekly bases but that prepares you for the exams. His exams are so similar to his notes. Would recommend taking the class with him cuz he's the greatest math teacher ever.

Review 16 [MATH3195] (quality=1.0, difficulty=4.0): Took his class during COVID and it was moved to online instead of in-person. Instead of making this transition and time easier, he refused to allow us to record lectures, was aggressive when asked to slow down for note-taking and then sent out a 6 paragraph tirade about how he refused to accommodate anyone and that his syllabus was sacrosanct

Review 17 [MATH2510] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Dr. Osita is a very good teacher and a very like-able guy. He really does care about his students and their ability to learn. If you show up and pay attention you should pass with a high B or A. He will help you when you need it and hes always available. Would highly recommend him as a first choice teacher. Would love to take his class again.

Review 18 [MATH2510] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Explains the course material in depth every class and helps students when they have questions or do not understand certain topics. Gives students the opportunity to test their knowledge of the material every class with practice problems/worksheets.

Review 19 [MATH2510] (quality=1.0, difficulty=4.0): The worst professor I've ever had. His lectures are comprised of him writing misleading/irrelevant information on the chalkboard and then you're told to complete a worksheet that provides no context to information just introduced. Dr. O puts in minimal effort and it's shown by the classes below average test performance.
